pins.notes: SLVSB02B pin functions, p. 3. VOUT is a sensing/load-switch input at the regulated rail after the external inductor; SW is not a regulated supply output.

simulation.scope: Buck circuit with external inductor/capacitor, VOUT 1.8 V, LOAD disabled, fixed 90% estimated conversion efficiency plus no-switching baseline IQ. Intended VIN 3.6 V; minimum 2.5 V enforces rating headroom; maximum 5.5 V is not enforced by the engine.
blockers: Characterize efficiency curves and the dependent load-switch path.
